notes.title: DRAMAtical Murder and other JAST visual novels on sale!
notes.content:
[h3][u]Steam Spring Sale is finally here![/u][/h3]

The blossoming cherry petals bring with it another season of flowers and sunshine. And this spring, [url=https://jastusa.com]JAST[/url] has an even better offer for you to make sure you enjoy this spring to its full extent. And this offer would be for a [u]limited time only[/u] so don't waste any time and [b]get your hands on a copy right now![/b] 💮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39806728/c59d96e065d5fd7d941184b6fc927ba1dd4b8a9d.png[/img]

[i]This Sale brings you DRAMAtical Murder at 40% off! This is an irresistible discount specially made for all our fans who have shown us love and support till now, so please go ahead and [b]enjoy this offer while it lasts.[/b]
And don't forget to [b]visit our website[/b] because this season [b]we're hosting more discounts for our other titles too![/b][/i]

[h2]Get [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1481080/DRAMAtical_Murder/]DRAMAtical Murder[/url] at a discount of 40% off![/h2]

And as always stay tuned to our [url=https://twitter.com/jast_uncensored]socials[/url] to keep yourself updated with the latest news from [b]JAST games[/b] and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rMGjzQE]Discord server[/url] for exclusive events and rewards.

[b]Thank you for the support,
And have a fun time![/b]
